page.title: Server admin
page.intro: This server's identity, health, limits and records. Only you, the owner, can see this page.

alerts.title: Alert rules
alerts.intro: You get a notification when a reading stays above the limit.
alerts.name: Rule name

limits.title: Agent limits
limits.intro: Memory and CPU caps for each agent's work. Leave a box empty for no cap.

bundle.title: Move an agent
bundle.intro: Export an agent with its chats to a file, then import it on this or another PasaBot server. Secrets, files and folders are not included.
bundle.imported: Imported. The agent and its chats are in your list.
bundle.failed: That file could not be imported.

diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.intro: A zip with health readings, settings summaries and recent logs for troubleshooting. Secret values are removed before it leaves the server.
